The stated warrant does not describe a consequence of the named alternative -- see the filed challenge for evidence and the warrant this defect actually needs (an imperative-continuity argument between v6-7 and v7’s own imperative, not the Hide-me clause).

Hide me under the shadow of your wings,” (web:Ps.17.8) runs directly into “from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.” (web:Ps.17.9). Both verses fall inside the '8-9' half of the row's own named alternative ('Splitting web:Ps.17.6-Ps.17.7 from web:Ps.17.8-Ps.17.9'), so that split leaves the quoted clause unbroken. web:Ps.17.7 (“Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.”) itself opens with a distinct imperative (הַפְלֵ֣ה, oshb:Ps.17.7, byte tier) -- the actual case for keeping 6-9 together must rest on the absence of an address/topic shift between v6's and v7's imperatives, not on the v8-9 clause the row cites.
